official_alert.headline: Shuttle Busing Between Norristown Transit Center and Bridgeport Station
official_alert.description: Bus service replaces train service from Norristown Transit Center to Bridgeport Station through December 19. Passengers should allow an additional 15 minutes for travel. For details and schedules, visit SEPTA.org. Shuttle bus information is available on a separate Shuttle Bus schedule page.
